Your Fundraising Team Carries Big Goals.
Raiser’s Edge NXT helps carry the work behind them — connecting your donor data, fundraising intelligence, and AI-powered tools into one platform, built for today’s work and ready for what’s next.

Raiser’s Edge NXT doesn’t just show you data — it turns it into direction. Built-in AI, grounded in decades of fundraising data, gives a real-time view of performance across annual giving, sustainers, and major gifts.
A single view of every supporter —giving history, engagement, and relationships live in one record, not scattered across systems or spreadsheets

The real story behind the top-line number —reporting by campaign, fund, and channel shows exactly where results are coming from, not just how much came in

Giving experiences built to convert —online giving that increases completed gifts and upgrades, with fee-cover options that help more reach your mission
More capacity without more headcount —Agents for Good™ work alongside your team on outreach sequencing and follow-up, always under your direction
A clear stage for every relationship —track prospects through identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship
A donor who feels known gives again. AI in Raiser’s Edge NXT helps your team show up to every relationship prepared, consistent, and never starting from a blank page.

Follow-through that never slips through the cracks —built-in guidance helps fundraisers plan next steps and keep stewardship consistent across their portfolio
A giving experience donors actually enjoy —mobile-first forms, flexible payment options, and self-service portals meet supporters where they are
Communication on the donor’s terms —flexible consent and channel preferences make sure every message reaches donors the way they actually want to hear from you
The full story on every donor —email, events, and membership are built into Raiser’s Edge NXT, so your team sees every touchpoint, not fragments
The right message, automatically —Workflow Designer builds multi-step email and outreach sequences triggered by the segments and conditions you set

Growth shouldn’t mean replacing your software every few years. Raiser’s Edge NXT is built to scale with you, from your first campaign to your largest, so the platform you start with is the one you can grow with.

AI grounded in real fundraising context, not generic automation —built on decades of sector-specific data, so what it surfaces is meaningful and defensible

Annual giving and major gifts are only part of the story. Raiser’s Edge NXT runs membership, giving societies, and planned giving in the same solution.
Membership and patron programs, built in —manage upgrades, renewals, downgrades, and drops alongside the gifts that fund them, in the same system
Legacy giving societies that maintain themselves —recognition programs for donors with planned or bequest gifts qualify and track automatically, no manual list-building
Planned gifts tracked with the same rigor as every other gift —vehicles, assets, beneficiaries, and realized revenue are structured data, not a note in a file
Corporate and employee gifts, without the wait —the Blackbaud Verified Network connects nonprofits to corporate giving programs, cutting disbursement from months to as little as 10 minutes
Grant management without the spreadsheet chaos —track applications and deadlines in the same solution as your other cultivation work
Peer-to-peer fundraising, natively connected —a built-in JustGiving integration syncs fundraiser, donor, and gift data straight into the same donor record
A platform your technical team can build on —public developer access across constituents, gifts, memberships, and more lets your team extend Raiser’s Edge NXT on your terms

Learn More About Blackbaud AI

Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT is best for mid-sized to large nonprofits that rely on relationship‑based fundraising and need a scalable donor management system. It’s ideal for nonprofits with dedicated development teams that manage individual giving, major gifts, campaigns, and grants, and that require deep donor insights, portfolio management, and reliable reporting.

Raiser’s Edge NXT is designed to reduce disconnected systems by keeping fundraising, engagement, and reporting workflows connected in one platform using a fundraising-first data model. Online donations, memberships, and event registrations flow directly into donor records, trigger acknowledgements automatically, and support reporting without manual exports or reconciliation. For organizations with additional tools, an open API, lowcode tools, and an extensible integration ecosystem help connect your other essential systems—so data stays aligned as volume and complexity grow.

Integrating Raiser’s Edge NXT with Financial Edge NXT helps operations teams reduce reconciliation work, improve data confidence, and keep fundraising and finance aligned throughout the full lifecycle of a gift or grant. With both systems connected, teams gain shared visibility from funding to disbursement, making it easier to track where money came from, which fund it was applied to, and how it was ultimately used—helping ensure gifts and grants are used for their intended purposes and supporting transparency for restricted funds. This reduces manual crosschecking between systems, lowers reporting and audit risk, and gives both development and finance teams confidence they are working from the same, trusted data—without relying on spreadsheets or parallel processes.

Raiser’s Edge NXT is designed to reduce the time it takes to answer leadership questions by providing pre-built fundraising dashboards designed for fundraising roles (operations, gift officers, leadership). Real-time visibility into key metrics, role-based views, one-click exports, and strategic recommendations based on performance benchmarking all contribute to faster, more confident decisions. It also helps teams proactively spot at-risk donors and analyze campaign and fund performance without having to combine multiple reports in Excel.

Raiser’s Edge NXT helps eliminate “spreadsheet fundraising” by automating core processes—reducing the need to move data between systems. Online gifts, event registrations, and membership purchases flow directly into the database, gift receipts are sent automatically, and workflows trigger next steps based on gift amount, giving capacity, or donor type. Bulk gift processing and mobile activity logging further reduce administrative effort, so staff spend less time on data entry and more time on donor cultivation and strategy. These automations are embedded in core fundraising workflows, so teams can reduce manual work without building custom processes from scratch.

Raiser’s Edge NXT supports stronger data integrity through built-in, flexible duplicate detection for records created with online donations, membership purchases, event registrations, and email signups. Batch tools include validation rules for consistent entry and data health services (for address and credit card updates) help keep contact information current and sustainer gifts flowing. Relationship tracking and soft credits connect households, employers, and affiliations—so teams can trust their reporting and segmentation and avoid costly outreach mistakes.
Blackbaud is the global leader in nonprofit fundraising software. Imagine what’s possible for your team with the market’s deepest expertise.
With Blackbaud, artificial intelligence is more than a marketing buzzword. It’s a proven strategy to unleash your fundraising potential. Let us show you how.
Connect with fundraising peers in our online Community, learn from our vast Knowledgebase , and count on our dedicated support team. We’re by your side.
Take the next step toward your organization’s success with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT. A Blackbaud expert will reach out to schedule a customized demo.
